```{r}
#| context: setup
#| echo: false
#| output: false
#| warning: false

library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)
library(DT)

# Load combined data
df <- read.csv("combinedratedata.csv", 
               check.names = FALSE, 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  mutate(`Utility Name` = str_squish(`Utility Name`)) |>
  filter(`Utility Name` != "City of St. Cloud")

# Load separated data
df_separated <- read.csv('separatedratedata.csv', 
               check.names = FALSE, 
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  mutate(`Utility Name` = str_squish(`Utility Name`)) |>
  filter(`Utility Name` != "City of St. Cloud")

# Load utility data
df_utilities <- read.csv('FL_Utility_Data.csv', 
                         check.names = FALSE, 
                         stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    `Utility Name` = str_squish(`Utility Name`),
    pop_cat = cut(
      Population,
      breaks = c(0, 50000, 100000, Inf),
      labels = c("0 to 50,000 Pop.",
                 "50,000 to 100,000 Pop.",
                 "Over 100,000 Pop."),
      right = FALSE
    )
  ) |>
  select(`Utility Name`, WMD, pop_cat, County)

# Join utility attributes onto main datasets
df <- df |> left_join(df_utilities, by = "Utility Name")
df_separated <- df_separated |> left_join(df_utilities, by = "Utility Name")

# Define function to clean columns
clean_currency <- function(x) {
  as.numeric(gsub("[\\$,]", "", as.character(x)))
}

# Clean fields that will be used and drop unnecessary fields
df <- df |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Minimum Charge`,
      `Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`,
      `Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))

# select columns
df <- df |> select(-any_of(c("Rates Effective Date", "Unit")))


df_separated_water <- df_separated |> 
  select(any_of(c('Utility Name',
           'Water Minimum Charge',
           'Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
           'Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)',
           'WMD', 'pop_cat', 'County')))

df_separated_water <- df_separated_water |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Water Minimum Charge`,
      `Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`,
      `Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))

df_separated_wastewater <- df_separated |> 
  select(any_of(c('Utility Name',
                  'Wastewater Minimum Charge',
                  'Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
                  'Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)',
                  'WMD', 'pop_cat', 'County')))


df_separated_wastewater <- df_separated_wastewater |>
  mutate(across(
    c(`Wastewater Minimum Charge`,
      `Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`,
      `Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    clean_currency
  ))


# format combined dataset for box plots
df_long <- df |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Minimum Charge`, 
             `Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)`, 
             `Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# format water dataset for box plots
df_long_water <- df_separated_water |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Water Minimum Charge`, 
             `Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`, 
             `Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))


# format wastewater dataset for box plots
df_long_wastewater <- df_separated_wastewater |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(`Wastewater Minimum Charge`, 
             `Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)`, 
             `Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)`),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Value))
```

# Sidebar {.sidebar}

```{r}
#| echo: false

# select Toho by default
selectInput(
  inputId = "selected_utility",
  label = "Select Utility to Compare:",
  choices = sort(unique(df$`Utility Name`)),
  selected = "Toho Water Authority"
)

# Population Category Filter
selectizeInput(
  inputId = "selected_pop_cat",
  label = "Population Category:",
  choices = levels(df_utilities$pop_cat),
  selected = levels(df_utilities$pop_cat),
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))
)

# Water Management District Filter
selectizeInput(
  inputId = "selected_wmd",
  label = "Select Water Management District:",
  choices = sort(unique(na.omit(df_utilities$WMD))),
  selected = sort(unique(na.omit(df_utilities$WMD))),
  multiple = TRUE,
  options = list(plugins = list("remove_button"))
)
```

```{r}
#| context: server

colors <- c('#00AA65', '#0953A2', '#e3eefd')


# filtered data frames with slicers

filtered_df <- reactive({
  req(input$selected_wmd, input$selected_pop_cat)
  df |>
    filter(
      (WMD %in% input$selected_wmd & pop_cat %in% input$selected_pop_cat) |
      (`Utility Name` == input$selected_utility)
    )
})

filtered_df_separated_water <- reactive({
  req(input$selected_wmd, input$selected_pop_cat)
  df_separated_water |>
    filter(
      (WMD %in% input$selected_wmd & pop_cat %in% input$selected_pop_cat) |
      (`Utility Name` == input$selected_utility)
    )
})

filtered_df_separated_wastewater <- reactive({

      (`Utility Name` == input$selected_utility)
    )
})

filtered_df_long <- reactive({

  df_long |>
    filter(
      (WMD %in% input$selected_wmd & pop_cat %in% input$selected_pop_cat) |

filtered_df_long_water <- reactive({

filtered_df_long_wastewater <- reactive({

      (WMD %in% input$selected_wmd & pop_cat %in% input$selected_pop_cat) |
      (`Utility Name` == input$selected_utility)
    )
})


# Box Plot Function

create_rate_boxplot <- function(full_long_df, 
                                target_utility, 
                                plot_subtitle, 
                                accent_color) {
  
  req(target_utility)
  n_orgs <- n_distinct(full_long_df$`Utility Name`)
  
  selected_df <- full_long_df |> 
    filter(`Utility Name` == target_utility) |>
    rowwise() |>
    mutate(
      Percentile = round(mean(full_long_df$Value[full_long_df$Metric == Metric] <= Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 100),
      Rank = n_orgs - sum(full_long_df$Value[full_long_df$Metric == Metric] > Value, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) |>
    ungroup()
  
  # Build plot
  ggplot(full_long_df, aes(x = Value, y = fct_reorder(Metric, Value, .fun = median, .desc = TRUE))) +
    # Boxplot params
    geom_boxplot(fill = "#e3eefd", 
                 color = "#CCCCCC",
                 alpha = 0.7, 
                 outlier.shape = NA, 
                 height = 0.5) +
    
    # Add point for selected company's value
    geom_point(data = selected_df, 
               aes(x = Value, 
                   y = fct_reorder(Metric, 
                                   Value, .fun = median, 
                                   .desc = TRUE)), 
               color = "#00AA65", 
               size = 3.5, 
               shape = 18) +
    
    # Add text label
    geom_text(data = selected_df,
              aes(x = Value, 
                  y = fct_reorder(Metric, 
                                  Value, .fun = median, 
                                  .desc = TRUE), 
                  label = paste0(target_utility, 
                                 ": $", 
                                 sprintf("%.2f", Value), 
                                 " (", Percentile, "%ile)\n",
                                 "Rank ", 
                                 Rank, "/", 
                                 n_orgs, 
                                 " Utilities")),
              hjust = 0, 
              vjust = -0.6, 
              color = "black", 
              fontface = "bold", 
              size = 4) +
    
    # Add axis labels and titles
    labs(
      title = paste("Rate Comparison:", target_utility, " vs. Competitors"),
      subtitle = paste(plot_subtitle, "| (n =", n_orgs, "utilities)"),
      x = "Amount ($)",
      y = "",
      caption = "Source: Raftelis — Florida Water and Wastewater Rate Survey (2026)"
    ) +
        
    # Plot theme and aesthetics
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title.position = "plot",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
          plot.background = element_rect(color = accent_color, 
                                         linewidth = 2, 
                                         linetype = "solid"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, 
                                      color = "#666666", 
                                      face = "italic", 
                                      hjust = .5),
          panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#EBEBF4", linewidth = 0.5), 
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()) +
    
    expand_limits(x = max(full_long_df$Value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.35)
}




# Render Plots

output$combined_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(filtered_df_long(), 
                      input$selected_utility, 
                      "Combined Rates", 
                      colors[3])
})

output$water_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(filtered_df_long_water(), 
                      input$selected_utility, 
                      "Water-Only Rates", 
                      colors[2])
})

output$wastewater_plot <- renderPlot({
  create_rate_boxplot(filtered_df_long_wastewater(), 
                      input$selected_utility, 
                      "Wastewater-Only Rates", 
                      colors[1])
})






# Render Dynamic Tables

combined_table_cols <- c(
  'Utility Name',
  'Minimum Charge',
  'Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35 Ccf)',
  'Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)'
)

water_table_cols <- c(
  'Utility Name',
  'Water Minimum Charge',
  'Water Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
  'Water Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)'
)

wastewater_table_cols <- c(
  'Utility Name',
  'Wastewater Minimum Charge',
  'Wastewater Bill at 4,000 Gal (5.35Ccf)',
  'Wastewater Bill at 8,000 Gal (10.70 Ccf)'
)

output$combined_table <- DT::renderDT({
  DT::datatable(
    filtered_df() |>
      select(any_of(combined_table_cols)), 
    rownames = FALSE,
    caption = htmltools::tags$caption(
      style = 'caption-side: top;',
      htmltools::tags$div(
        style = paste0(
          'font-weight: bold; ',
          'font-size: 14px; ',
          'color: #333; ',
          'padding-bottom: 4px; ',
          'margin-bottom: 4px; ',
          'border-bottom: 3px solid ', colors[3], '; ',
          'display: inline-block;'                        
        ),
        'Combined Rate Data Overview'
      ),
      htmltools::tags$div(
        style = 'font-size: 11px; color: #666; font-style: italic; margin-bottom: 8px;',
        'Source: Raftelis — Florida Water and Wastewater Rate Survey (2026)'
      )
    ),
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25, 
      scrollX = TRUE,
      initComplete = DT::JS(
        "function(settings, json) {",
        "  $(this.api().table().container()).css('font-size', '12px');",
        "}"
      )
    )
  ) |>
    # Highlight row matching selected utility
    DT::formatStyle(
      'Utility Name',
      target = 'row',
      backgroundColor = DT::styleEqual(
        input$selected_utility, 
        '#e3eefd'
      ),
      fontWeight = DT::styleEqual(
        input$selected_utility, 
        'bold'
      )
    )
})
```
